rationale: The plan fits the 6 vs 6 unpaired single-batch design with a PyDESeq2 Wald test, an explicit ~condition formula with vehicle as reference, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, a justified minimal filter (>=10 counts in the smallest group size), BH at 0.05, and apeglm-equivalent shrinkage kept out of the test and out of the TF input. QC is complete (blind VST, top-500 PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, flagging policy) and the report block names method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested/DE, CollecTRI version, estimator, minimum regulon size, regulators tested, and the inference caution. The TF step uses decoupler ulm on signed CollecTRI from the local CSV with min size 5 and statsmodels BH, but it only specifies the per-sample log2 CPM route in its acceptance criteria rather than the contrast-level ulm on the full Wald statistic that the reference treats as the primary inference, and the rpy2 read of the DoRothEA .rda depends on an R runtime, which strains the Python-only constraint.
